beforeYouStart: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run (PowerPyx). Cheats only unlock after the story anyway.
There is no mission replay and no New Game+. The game has 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave — keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (PowerPyx, OutputLag).
Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude (a Chapter 1 meditation). Everything else can be finished in free-roam after the story.

The 100% checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made during the story already counts — so scan vehicles, study animals and do side content as you go.
estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies (PowerPyx). The story takes 60–80 hours; the 100% checklist is the long tail.

stages.name: Play the story — and catch the one missable
stages.text: Finish all five chapters in order. Every chapter and named-mission trophy pops automatically as you play — none of them can be missed. While you play, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars: both feed the 100% checklist later. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the moment Lucia offers it (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only thing in the game reported as missable.

stages.name: Side questlines and strangers
stages.text: Clear the optional questlines: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton (treasure diving), Billy (Mud Club), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason-only, destroy the labs) and Bret (hunting, Jason-only). Then finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. On the way, beat Cal at fishing and finish one arcade game.

stages.name: Collectibles, exploration and property
stages.text: Finish the open-world collecting: 3 card sets, WAiNK scans at 100 spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all 18 meditation spots, and fly a plane over the whole map to unfog Leonida. Buy all 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app ($160,000) and register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app — garages first, because each one adds parking spots.

stages.name: Activities and challenges
stages.text: The grind stage. 250 stunts (100% wants 300), gold at all 42 shooting range challenges, a Top Fun drone race won at all 14 locations, 20 different races won, 50 challenges done (100% wants 70 of 80) and one of each of the 9 activity types. Most of these overlap with the 100% checklist, so work from the checklist and tick them off together.

stages.name: Robberies, money and mayhem
stages.text: Work through the robbery set: jewelry stores (stealth, with the Snap Gun), 5 bank vaults (100% wants all 8), an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang (100% wants all 39), 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, and a 4-star wanted level escaped with your partner. Alongside it, build Criminal Profile actions toward 500, max out strength with both characters together, steal a Rhino tank and a docked plane at VCIA, and launder $250,000 in marked bills / spend $100,000 in shops. The four cryptic trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) sit here too — no guide has confirmed their methods yet, so check the linked sources before chasing them.

stages.name: The 100% checklist and the platinum
stages.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear what is left. It is roughly 60% of true completion, so most of it is already done if you followed the stages above. The full-requirement items are the ones to verify: all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all 15 Target Decks, all 39 gang operations. When the checklist hits 100%, A Long Road pops — and with every other trophy earned, Vice Got a Price! follows at once.

title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
